_comment: ComfyUI Workflow A — Nebula parallax tiles via the Space Image ZIT LoRA (ZImageTurbo base, trigger 'Sp11'). API-format graph: POST to /prompt as {"prompt": <this>}. Forked from workflow_api.json; adds a LoraLoader (node 10) between the checkpoint and the sampler. Replace [PALETTE_PROMPT] / [LAYER] / [PALETTE] before queueing — see docs/design/ART_PROMPTS.md '### Nebula (Space ZIT LoRA)'.

layers.far: low density, faint glow — set LoraLoader strength_model/strength_clip to 0.6
layers.mid: medium structure, visible gas lanes — strength 0.8

_generation_notes.positive_prompt: Set node 6 text to 'Sp11, [PALETTE_PROMPT]' from ART_PROMPTS.md. Negative (node 7) is fixed for all palettes.
_generation_notes.filename_prefix: Set node 9 to 'nebula/[PALETTE]_[LAYER]' (palette first, e.g. 'nebula/red_far') — matches src/assets/manifest.ts and the pickVariant('nebula', '<palette>_<layer>') consumer.

inputs.text: planets, ships, text, watermark, blurry, low quality, lens flare
